spawn.name: Starting Room
spawn.description:
A sliver of dust-filled sunbeams pierces through the warped wood planks of the door, casting elongated shadows across the stone floor. The air hangs thick with the scent of decay – musty earth and the faintest trace of mildew - an unsettling harmony against the silence of the room.  

To the East a broken door creaks slightly in the stale air as if protesting at your touch.

broken_door.name: Broken Door
broken_door.description: Skittering sounds can be heard from behind the door.

dark_hallway.name: Dark Hallway
dark_hallway.description: A dark hallway. The sound of tiny feet skittering on stone.

locked_door.name: Sturdy Locked Door
locked_door.description: You should have brought an Orc.

ledgerfall_market.name: Ledgerfall Market
ledgerfall_market.description: To the West you see a bustling market place.

quite_street_west.name: West Quiet Street
quite_street_west.description: A street urchin lurks in the shadows
